            # Online Boutique 排查总则

## 经验条目

以下条目来自过去的排查记录，括号里是来源。

- [E1]（BH01、BH02、BH03、BH07、BH10）【已证实】调用方连不上某个下游时，Endpoints、端口和地址配置都要核对。适用：调用方日志出现 dial tcp <地址>:<端口> connection refused 或 i/o timeout；或上游返回 Internal/Unavailable，错误文本指出某一步下游调用失败，而该下游自身日志无错误（仍在处理其他请求，或根本没收到请求）。不适用：下游自身日志有报错或处理耗时变大，应改查该下游的负载和它的依赖。做法：(1) 查该 Service 的 Endpoints，subsets 为空时比较 selector 和 Pod labels，并看 replicas 是否为 0；(2) Endpoints 有地址时逐段比较端口链：错误文本端口、调用方 *_ADDR 等地址环境变量、Service port、targetPort 与 Endpoints 端口、containerPort 及下游启动日志里的实际监听端口。错误端口等于 Service port 不代表没问题，targetPort 指向未监听端口同样会立即 refused；连 Service 未暴露的端口可能表现为 i/o timeout，超时也要先核对端口；(3) 拿线上配置与 last-applied-configuration、旧 ReplicaSet 模板比较，看改动时间是否和症状起点吻合。修正后这类报错和对应接口的失败应归零。例：几次分别是 selector 指错标签、调用方地址里的端口错误、Service targetPort 与容器监听端口不一致。
- [E2]（BH01、BH02、BH03、BH04、BH05、BH06、BH08、BH09）【已证实】变慢定位到下游后，按往返次数找到具体一跳，再区分应用内慢和网络路径慢。适用：调用方各接口耗时随调用某些下游（含缓存、数据库等非gRPC依赖）的次数成比例增加，不调它们的接口和健康检查仍然很快。不适用：下游日志里单个请求的处理耗时同样变大，应改查它的CPU节流、负载或它的下游。做法：列出每个接口对每一跳的往返次数，看耗时是否按某一跳次数成固定台阶增长，定位到具体一跳（含二级下游）；按调用方发起时刻、下游入口日志、下游完成日志、调用方拿到响应后的下一条日志逐跳对时，发起到入口间隔大而内部处理和回程都快，说明延迟在应用之外；另一独立调用方同样变慢，说明慢点在下游一侧。随后查该跳两端Pod所在节点的veth tc qdisc和网络策略。没有cfs throttled指标不能下CPU节流结论；无节点权限时只写“网络路径或进程内”并申请节点侧检查。重建Pod、调大CPU limit能否消除仍未验证，几次都是直接清除规则后恢复。例：一次是被调用服务的veth带规则。
- [E3]（BH01、BH03、BH06、BH09、BH14、BH15、CL03）【已排除】多个症状同时出现时，不要默认它们是同一个根因，也不要因为失败调用耗时短就断定报错链路和变慢无关。适用：用户侧或调用方日志同时出现错误或warning级的下游调用失败（connection refused、i/o timeout、Endpoints为空等），又有整体或部分请求变慢。不适用：只有一种症状。做法：按症状分别找证据链；一次只修一处，每步之后分别看错误数、慢请求占比、中位数和各分位数，并确认前后比较窗口的请求量相当。修好报错后延迟分布不变，说明报错链路不是变慢原因，要继续单独追查变慢；延迟部分下降但没有归零，既不能据此排除报错链路的贡献，也不能把它当作主因，要继续查其他来源，修完后看是否归零。调用方日志里立即失败的调用耗时很短，只能作参考，以修复后的分位数为准；去掉延迟来源也不能代替修复报错。例：几次修好端口、selector或副本为0的下游后，慢请求占比不变；一次把副本为0的广告服务恢复后，慢请求占比和p99明显下降但没有归零，恢复另一服务的CPU配额后才归零，前一步下降的原因没有查明。
- [E4]（BH04、CL05）【已证实】多个服务同时显得变慢时，先找最小源头集合，不要把每个变慢的服务都当作根因。适用：调用方日志或逐跳对时显示多个下游的调用耗时同时变大；或某下游被判为变慢但自身CPU、throttled、内存、日志都正常，且它本身还会调用其他下游。不适用：只有一个下游变慢且它不再调用其他服务，按E2处理。做法：(1)对每个变慢的服务，把自身处理时间和等待下游的时间分开算；只是在等下游、自身处理不慢的先标为“继承”，从调用图叶子一侧查源头，修复后看继承的服务是否一起恢复；(2)仅凭某次调用前后的时间差归因不可靠，差值可能包含其他调用；(3)从另一调用方得到的下游“很快”的证据，要按它对该下游的调用次数折算，并和该调用方健康期耗时比较，比健康期明显变长就不能据此排除该下游。例：一次推荐服务被怀疑单次调用变慢，自身资源全部正常，清除其下游商品目录Pod的veth规则后恢复。
- [E5]（BH07、BH10）【已排除】调用方日志里的下游报错或某个下游的配置错误，不一定是用户侧失败的原因，要区分被降级的依赖和致命的必经步骤。适用：调用方日志或配置检查同时发现多个下游有问题（调用报错、Endpoints 为空、端口不一致等），且用户侧有 500 或某个操作失败。不适用：只有一个下游有问题，直接按 E1 处理。做法：把每类下游报错和同一条请求日志的路径、返回状态对应：报错出现时请求仍返回 200 的，是被调用方降级处理的依赖，只影响页面部分内容；报错文本出现在返回 500 的请求里、且属于该操作必经步骤的，才是失败候选。还可看必经步骤之后的下游是否几乎没有来自该调用方的日志，确认流程在哪一步中断。修复时一次只改一处，每步之后分别看 500 数和对应操作失败数：修好降级依赖后两者不变，即排除它对失败的贡献；修好必经步骤后失败归零才算证实。例：两次先恢复没有流量的推荐或广告服务，500 和下单失败都不变；改正必经下游的端口配置后全部恢复。
- [E6]（BH08）【已排除】故障前后出现的手工配置改动不一定是根因，要用时间线和回滚后的数字检验。适用：某Deployment的env与last-applied-configuration不一致，或新ReplicaSet创建时间接近症状开始。不适用：调用方报错文本指向地址或端口，按E1核对。做法：比较新Pod Ready时刻、新Pod上线后第一批请求的耗时和状态、症状起点；新Pod已经正常服务一段时间后症状才出现，说明该改动不是触发点，应继续按症状找证据链，不要停在这个改动上。如果仍要回滚，回滚后分别看错误数和各分位数，都没有变化即排除它。例：一次删掉调用方多出的发布标签环境变量并滚动更新后，慢请求占比和各分位数不变。
- [E7]（BH11、BH12、BH13、BH14、BH15、CL01）【已证实】部分请求变慢时，按“每次调用有一定概率被加上一段固定延迟”定位到具体一跳。适用：用户侧中位数正常、高分位很差；慢请求耗时集中在正常值加某个固定量或其整数倍；不调后端的接口始终很快。不适用：所有请求一起变慢，或下游日志里单个请求处理耗时变大，按E2或查下游负载；某Pod的cfs throttled周期占比明显高于其他Pod时，同样会中位数正常、长尾变差，按CPU限流条目检验。做法：(1)数出每个接口对每个下游的调用次数，含间接调用和二级依赖；(2)优先看只调一个下游的接口；多步请求用相邻下游入口日志时间戳夹出空转区间，某下游日志的空档可能是调用方在等别的下游，对齐入口和完成时间后再归因；(3)只出现在某一个Pod上的kubelet探针连接超时可作佐证，但被CPU限流的Pod也可能出现，要结合throttled指标；(4)查该Pod两端veth的tc qdisc。同时有5xx时报错与长尾分开修分开看（见E3）。例：一次只清除商品目录Pod的veth规则后长尾全部消失。
- [E8]（CL01、CL02、CL03、CL04、CL05）【已证实】请求变慢时，用限流指标、配置历史和恢复配额后的各分位数检验某一跳的CPU限流，并确认它解释了多少延迟。适用：某Pod的cfs throttled周期占比明显高于同命名空间其他Pod，慢请求都经过该服务；常伴随limits.cpu比上一版ReplicaSet模板低、探针超时事件、日志无报错。不适用：各Pod throttled都接近0或差不多，改查网络路径（E2、E7）或下游排队；调用方有连接报错先按E1、E5。做法：(1)平均用量远低于limit也可能被限流，不能据此排除；(2)逐字段diff当前和上一版ReplicaSet模板，核对改动时间与症状起点；(3)这些证据全部吻合，即使它是唯一的配置改动、受限Pod是入口服务，也只说明存在限流，不说明它是主因，被慢接口调用的其他下游要按E9一并列为候选；(4)恢复limit后分别看throttled占比、慢请求占比、中位数和p99：都回到正常才算证实，慢请求占比基本不变说明限流不是主因。例：两次恢复换算服务limit后长尾消失；另有三次（含一次入口服务配额下调且时间吻合）恢复后不变，清除另一下游veth规则后才恢复。
- [E9]（CL02、CL04、CL05）【已排除】慢接口都调用某服务、快接口都不调用，不足以把变慢归给它；同一组接口共同调用的其他下游都是候选，Pod层指标正常、和调用方在同一节点也不能排除其网络路径。适用：按接口比较调用方日志耗时后，慢接口与快接口的调用差别对应不止一个下游（含间接调用和页面附属调用）。不适用：存在只调用其中一个候选的接口，且其耗时已在健康基线水平，能把候选区分开。做法：(1)为每个接口列出全部直接和间接下游，找出与慢接口调用集合重合的所有服务；(2)“快”接口要先和健康期基线比，若它也明显变慢，说明它同样经过慢点，不能当对照，它和慢接口共同调用的下游都要列为候选；(3)对每个候选分别取证：throttled占比、配置历史、探针事件、该Pod两端veth的tc qdisc；CPU低、throttled为0、无事件、丢包为0都不能排除tc延迟；(4)一次只修一个候选，每步看慢请求占比、中位数和p99，不变即排除。例：一次首页比健康期慢一个数量级却被当作快对照，变慢被归给推荐服务，清除两类页面都会调用的商品目录veth规则后全部恢复。
- [E10]（CL06、CL07）【已证实】调用方报下游返回 Unimplemented/Method not found 时，核对请求实际被路由到了哪个服务。适用：调用方或上游错误文本含 rpc error code = Unimplemented（如 Method not found），失败请求立即返回；预期的下游日志里没有对应调用。不适用：报 connection refused、i/o timeout 或 Endpoints 为空，按E1；下游自身日志有报错，改查该下游。做法：(1)从调用方启动日志或 env 取出该下游的 *_ADDR，与预期服务名和端口比较；(2)地址正确时查该 Service 的 selector 和 EndpointSlice 里的 Pod 名，看是否选中了另一个监听同端口服务的 Pod，可与其他 Service 的 EndpointSlice 对比；(3)看预期下游是否完全没有业务请求、被选中的服务日志是否只有它自己的方法；(4)比较当前配置与 last-applied-configuration 或上一版 ReplicaSet 模板，核对改动时间与症状起点；(5)改正后按E11确认各调用方已切到正确后端，再看 500 和对应操作失败数是否归零。Endpoints 都 ready、端口一致不能排除这类错误。例：一次支付地址指向了邮件服务；一次配送 Service 的 selector 选中了支付服务的 Pod。
- [E11]（CL07）【已证实】改正 Service selector、Endpoints 或地址后报错不降，要考虑调用方仍复用指向旧后端的长连接，按调用方逐个重建并分别验证。适用：路由配置已改正，EndpointSlice 已指向正确 Pod，但调用方日志里同一错误文本仍持续出现，500 或对应操作失败数不降；正确后端仍几乎收不到来自这些调用方的请求。不适用：EndpointSlice 仍为空或指向错误 Pod，先按E1、E10改正配置；正确后端已收到请求但自身报错，改查该后端。做法：(1)列出所有直接调用该下游的服务，把每个失败接口对应到实际发起这次调用的一方；(2)一次只重建（或让其重连）一个调用方，每步后分别看它负责的操作失败数和其余 500：只有它负责的那部分归零，说明各调用方各自持有旧连接，要逐个处理；(3)同时看正确后端日志是否开始出现来自该调用方的请求。调用方未重连前，失败不降不能当作配置修正无效的证据。例：一次改正配送 Service 的 selector 后 500 和下单失败都不变，重建结算服务后下单失败归零，再重建前端后 500 归零。

<!-- 经验条目结束 -->

## 1. 权限与证据边界

- 只在命名空间 `boutique` 内排查，使用只读权限。
- 可查看：Pod、Pod 日志、事件、Service、EndpointSlice、Deployment、ReplicaSet、ConfigMap、ResourceQuota。
- 不可用：进入容器执行命令、查看节点、查看监控指标；系统没有 CPU、内存、延迟指标。
- 结论必须来自上述可见证据。无法验证的内容写成“先确认……”或“现有权限内无法确认”，不要根据服务名、调用关系或常见经验直接下根因。
- 不要编造日志格式、接口、配置项；日志字段含义先确认。

## 2. 调用关系

- 用户从 `frontend` 进入。
- `loadgenerator` 持续产生访问流量；其具体访问目标先确认，不纳入下列服务调用图，也不假设存在 `boutique-loadgenerator`。
- `frontend` -> `productcatalogservice`、`currencyservice`、`cartservice`、`recommendationservice`、`shippingservice`、`checkoutservice`、`adservice`
- `checkoutservice` -> `productcatalogservice`、`shippingservice`、`paymentservice`、`emailservice`、`currencyservice`、`cartservice`
- `recommendationservice` -> `productcatalogservice`
- `cartservice` -> `redis-cart`
- 不调用其他服务：`emailservice`、`paymentservice`、`productcatalogservice`、`currencyservice`、`shippingservice`、`adservice`、`redis-cart`

调用关系只表示依赖方向，不等于故障传播方向。

## 3. 入口 SOP 选择

先固定用户症状：发生时间、频率、影响的功能/操作、是否持续、是否与 `loadgenerator` 流量相关。不要先假定某个服务故障。

默认规则：

- 用户可见问题且无法明确指向某个后端服务：从 `boutique-frontend` 进入。
- 症状或已有证据明确指向某个服务及其对应操作：可直接进入该服务 SOP；仍要按第 4 节确认证据，不要跳过入口症状。
- 只有 `loadgenerator` 报错：先确认其访问目标和错误内容；若指向 `frontend` 或用户访问路径，从 `boutique-frontend` 进入。不要假设存在 `loadgenerator` 的 SOP。
- 不明确时回退到 `boutique-frontend`。

| 症状/已有证据明确指向 | 入口 skill |
|---|---|
| `frontend` 页面、入口、多个功能同时异常，或无法判断后端 | `boutique-frontend` |
| 商品目录、商品信息 | `boutique-productcatalogservice` |
| 币种、换算 | `boutique-currencyservice` |
| 购物车操作 | `boutique-cartservice` |
| 推荐内容 | `boutique-recommendationservice` |
| 运费、配送 | `boutique-shippingservice` |
| 下单、结账编排 | `boutique-checkoutservice` |
| 支付 | `boutique-paymentservice` |
| 邮件通知 | `boutique-emailservice` |
| 广告 | `boutique-adservice` |
| 已有证据指向购物车存储 `redis-cart`，或从 `cartservice` SOP 转入 | `boutique-redis-cart` |

## 4. 跨服务跳转原则

1. 只沿调用方向向下游跳，且必须带当前服务侧证据。可跳的证据包括：当前服务的日志、事件或状态显示对某个下游的调用失败、超时、连接失败、返回异常，并能定位到具体下游和操作；或当前服务自身已排除，请求路径明确只可能落在下游。仅凭“它是下游”“它也可能异常”不跳。
2. 跳转前记录：时间、当前服务对象、症状、指向下游的证据、已排除项。到下游后先核对同一时间窗、同一症状是否出现；对不上则回到当前服务，不能把无关异常归因给下游。
3. 反向查看调用方，只在当前服务有证据表明请求来源异常、请求内容异常或流量异常时进行；否则停在当前服务。
4. 结论归属：根因结论写在直接证据所在的最小服务上。调用方只写“受影响/依赖疑似异常”，不替下游下结论。若根因是调用方发出异常请求导致下游报错，结论写在调用方。多个服务受影响时，在源头服务写根因，在其他服务写影响并引用源头结论。
5. 停止条件：已定位到最小责任服务并有直接证据；或可见证据均不支持继续；或下一步需要进入容器、查看节点、查看监控指标、访问其他命名空间等无权限操作。停止时写明已排除项、未确认项、所需权限或补充信息，不要猜。

## 5. 多个服务同时异常时判断源头

- 先列出受影响服务、症状和最早异常时间，再按调用图找共同下游或共同依赖。共同依赖只是候选，不是根因。
- 看时序和错误形状：下游先异常、多个上游随后报同类依赖错误，优先查下游；上游先异常且下游日志或事件显示来自上游的异常请求/流量，优先查上游；只是同时异常不能定源。日志字段含义先确认。
- 对候选源头查直接证据：Pod 状态、日志、事件、Service、EndpointSlice、Deployment、ReplicaSet、ConfigMap、ResourceQuota。候选源头自身没有直接异常证据时，不把共同依赖写成源头，回到调用方或入口继续。

#!/bin/bash
# SECURITY: assign sanitized params to shell variables (unquoted slot),
# then reference them only as "$VAR" - never interpolate 
# inside a quoted context. See kubernetes_jq_query for the rationale.
KIND=pods
CUSTOM_COLUMNS='NAME:.metadata.name,STATUS:.status.phase,START:.status.startTime,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount,NODE:.spec.nodeName,IP:.status.podIP'
# 'namespace' is also a Jinja global (namespace()), so it is defined even when omitted
SEL_NAMESPACE=boutique
SEL_LABELS=
SEL_FIELDS=
FILTER_PATTERN=
# Strict tool calls send null for unset optional params, which renders as 'None'
[ "$SEL_NAMESPACE" = "None" ] && SEL_NAMESPACE=""
[ "$SEL_LABELS" = "None" ] && SEL_LABELS=""
[ "$SEL_FIELDS" = "None" ] && SEL_FIELDS=""
[ "$FILTER_PATTERN" = "None" ] && FILTER_PATTERN=""

# kubectl ignores -n for cluster-scoped kinds; say so instead of reporting a namespace that wasn't applied
NOTES='[]'
if [ -n "$SEL_NAMESPACE" ]; then
  is_kind() { awk -v kind="$KIND" '$1 == kind || index($1, kind ".") == 1 {found = 1} END {exit !found}'; }
  if kubectl api-resources --namespaced=false -o name 2>/dev/null | is_kind \
    && ! kubectl api-resources --namespaced=true -o name 2>/dev/null | is_kind; then
    NOTES=$(jq -nc --arg note "namespace '${SEL_NAMESPACE}' ignored: ${KIND} is cluster-scoped." '[$note]')
    SEL_NAMESPACE=""
  fi
fi

SCOPE_ARGS=()
if [ -n "$SEL_NAMESPACE" ]; then
  SCOPE_ARGS+=(-n "$SEL_NAMESPACE")
else
  SCOPE_ARGS+=(--all-namespaces)
fi
if [ -n "$SEL_LABELS" ]; then
  SCOPE_ARGS+=(-l "$SEL_LABELS")
fi
if [ -n "$SEL_FIELDS" ]; then
  SCOPE_ARGS+=(--field-selector "$SEL_FIELDS")
fi

err_file=$(mktemp)
output=$(kubectl get "$KIND" "${SCOPE_ARGS[@]}" -o custom-columns="$CUSTOM_COLUMNS" 2>"$err_file")
kubectl_exit=$?
err_content=$(cat "$err_file" 2>/dev/null)
rm -f "$err_file"

SCOPE='null'
if command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
  SCOPE=$(jq -nc --arg namespace "$SEL_NAMESPACE" --arg labels "$SEL_LABELS" --arg fields "$SEL_FIELDS" \
    '{namespace: (if $namespace == "" then null else $namespace end),
      label_selector: (if $labels == "" then null else $labels end),
      field_selector: (if $fields == "" then null else $fields end)}')
fi

if [ $kubectl_exit -ne 0 ] || [ -z "$output" ]; then
  if command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
    jq -n --arg stderr "$err_content" --argjson scope "$SCOPE" --argjson notes "$NOTES" \
      '{count: 0, header: null, rows: [], stderr: $stderr, scope: $scope, notes: $notes}'
  else
    echo "=== STDERR ==="
    echo "$err_content"
    echo "=== ROWS ==="
    echo "=== COUNT ==="
    echo 0
  fi
  exit 0
fi

# Split header and data rows
header=$(echo "$output" | head -1)
if [ -n "$FILTER_PATTERN" ]; then
  data=$(echo "$output" | tail -n +2 | grep -E -- "$FILTER_PATTERN" || true)
else
  data=$(echo "$output" | tail -n +2)
fi

if command -v jq &>/dev/null; then
  if [ -n "$data" ]; then
    count=$(echo "$data" | wc -l)
  else
    count=0
  fi
  # Rows go through stdin, not --argjson, so large tables don't hit "Argument list too long"
  printf '%s' "$data" | jq -R . | jq -s \
    --argjson count "$count" \
    --arg header "$header" \
    --arg stderr "$err_content" \
    --argjson scope "$SCOPE" \
    --argjson notes "$NOTES" \
    '{count: $count, header: $header, rows: ., stderr: (if $stderr == "" then null else $stderr end), scope: $scope, notes: $notes}'
else
  echo "=== STDERR ==="
  echo "$err_content"
  echo "=== HEADER ==="
  echo "$header"
  echo "=== ROWS ==="
  echo "$data"
  echo "=== COUNT ==="
  if [ -n "$data" ]; then echo "$data" | wc -l; else echo 0; fi
fi

<skill>
            # frontend 排查 SOP

适用症状：用户从 frontend 入口访问 Online Boutique 出现页面不可用、报错或入口功能异常，或 loadgenerator 访问 frontend 失败/异常。

## 信号 → 步骤

| 能观察到的信号 | 去哪 |
|---|---|
| Deployment 可用副本 < 1；Pod 非 Running/Ready；CrashLoopBackOff、ImagePullBackOff、Pending、FailedCreate | 第 1 步 |
| Pod Running 且 Ready，但 frontend Service 访问异常，或 EndpointSlice 无 ready endpoint | 第 2 步 |
| frontend 日志出现下游服务地址/服务名的连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 | 第 3 步；单个下游持续异常时按“什么时候跳到别的服务”跳转 |
| 事件或日志显示 `/_healthz` 探针失败、容器重启 | 第 4 步 |
| Pod/Service/EndpointSlice 正常，但用户报入口不可用，或 loadgenerator 无法连接 frontend | 第 5 步 |
| 多个下游同时报错，或所有下游地址解析失败 | 第 3 步先核对 frontend env 和下游 Service/EndpointSlice，不直接跳单个下游 |
| 确认某个下游持续异常，frontend 自身正常 | 跳到 skill `boutique-<下游服务>` |
| frontend 及所有下游均正常，仅入口请求未到达或外部访问失败 | 第 5 步，结论写入口/用户侧或 loadgenerator 侧 |

## 步骤

1. **查 frontend Deployment、ReplicaSet、Pod 和事件，先排除本服务发布/资源问题。**  
   执行 `kubectl -n boutique get deploy,rs,pod -l app=frontend -o wide`，再对异常 Pod 执行 `kubectl -n boutique describe pod <pod>` 和查看命名空间事件。重点看：Deployment 的 desired/ready/available，Pod phase、Ready、restartCount、containerStatuses 的 waiting/terminated reason，事件中的 `ImagePullBackOff`、`ErrImagePull`、`CrashLoopBackOff`、`OOMKilled`、`FailedScheduling`、`FailedCreate`。  
   - 镜像拉取失败：本服务镜像问题，先确认镜像名是否为清单中的 `frontend:v0.10.3`、仓库是否可达、拉取凭据是否可用；只读账号不能看节点，不要归因节点。  
   - `OOMKilled` 或反复重启：结合 limits `memory: 128Mi`、容器日志和事件判断是否为内存限制；没有监控指标，不能靠 CPU/内存曲线下结论。  
   - `FailedCreate`/Pending 且事件提到配额：查看 `kubectl -n boutique get resourcequota`，确认是否 ResourceQuota 不足。  
   - Pod 未 Ready 且事件指向探针：转到第 4 步；Pod 正常则转第 2 步。

2. **查 frontend Service 和 EndpointSlice，确认入口 Service 是否把流量送到 Ready Pod。**  
   执行 `kubectl -n boutique get svc frontend -o yaml` 和 `kubectl -n boutique get endpointslice -l kubernetes.io/service-name=frontend -o yaml`。核对 Service 的 selector 是否为 `app: frontend`，端口是否为 `port: 80`、`targetPort: 8080`，EndpointSlice 是否有 ready addresses。  
   - selector 或端口与清单不一致：本服务 Service 配置问题。  
   - EndpointSlice 为空但 Pod 已 Ready：先确认 readinessProbe 是否通过、Service selector 是否匹配；必要时回第 1、4 步。  
   - EndpointSlice 有 ready endpoint 但用户仍访问失败：继续第 3、5 步，区分 frontend 应用错误与入口访问链路问题。

3. **查 frontend 日志中的下游调用错误，按下游拆分。**  
   执行 `kubectl -n boutique logs deploy/frontend --tail=<合适行数>`；若容器重启过，再看 `--previous`。先确认实际日志格式，不要预设字段。检索清单中的下游地址/服务名：`productcatalogservice:3550`、`currencyservice:7000`、`cartservice:7070`、`recommendationservice:8080`、`shippingservice:50051`、`checkoutservice:5050`、`adservice:9555`。  
   - 只有一个下游地址持续出现连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应，且 frontend Pod/Service/EndpointSlice/探针正常：按“什么时候跳到别的服务”跳对应 skill。  
   - 多个下游同时报错：先核对 frontend 的 env 地址是否与清单一致，并只读查看对应下游 Service/EndpointSlice 是否存在；不要直接归因单个下游。若 env 与清单不一致，按本服务配置问题处理。  
   - 所有下游地址集体解析失败：在确认 frontend env 正确、下游 Service 存在后，结论写集群 DNS/网络侧，不跳单个下游。  
   - 清单中有 `SHOPPING_ASSISTANT_SERVICE_ADDR=shoppingassistantservice:80`，但给定调用关系未列出该下游；先确认实际是否被调用，不要据此跳到未列出的服务。

4. **查探针和 frontend 运行配置。**  
   核对 Deployment 中 `PORT=8080`、containerPort `8080`、readinessProbe/livenessProbe 均为 `httpGet /_healthz:8080`，并带清单中的 Cookie 头；initialDelaySeconds 均为 10。查看 Pod 事件和日志中是否出现探针失败、未监听端口、启动失败。  
   - 应用未监听 8080、PORT/containerPort/探针端口不一致：本服务配置问题。  
   - 探针失败同时伴随下游连接错误：回第 3 步判断是否由下游依赖导致。  
   - 探针失败但无下游错误：结论写 frontend Pod/探针配置或应用启动问题，证据用事件和日志。

5. **确认入口请求是否到达 frontend。**  
   用用户报告、loadgenerator Pod 状态/日志辅助判断，先确认 loadgenerator 实际日志格式。若 frontend 日志有持续请求且错误指向下游，回第 3 步；若 frontend 日志无请求、loadgenerator 日志显示无法连接 frontend，而 frontend Service/EndpointSlice 正常，检查第 2 步并判断为入口访问链路/用户侧或 loadgenerator 侧问题。frontend 是入口，没有上游微服务调用方；不要把它写成某个下游服务的调用方问题。loadgenerator 只作为流量来源，不写成 frontend 的下游服务。

6. **汇总结论并决定跳转。**  
   汇总 frontend Deployment/Pod/Service/EndpointSlice 状态、事件、日志中的下游地址错误，按下一节决定跳下游还是写入口侧结论。不要只写“重启/扩容试试”。

## 什么时候跳到别的服务

仅当 frontend Pod Running/Ready、frontend Service/EndpointSlice 正常、探针无明显失败，且 frontend 日志持续指向单个下游时跳转：

- frontend 日志持续出现 `productcatalogservice:3550` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-productcatalogservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `currencyservice:7000` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-currencyservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `cartservice:7070` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-cartservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `recommendationservice:8080` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-recommendationservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `shippingservice:50051` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-shippingservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `checkoutservice:5050` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-checkoutservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `adservice:9555` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-adservice`。  

回到调用方/入口侧的情形：

- frontend Deployment/Pod/Service/EndpointSlice 均正常，所有下游也未见持续错误，但用户访问失败或请求未到达 frontend：frontend 无上游微服务调用方，结论写在入口/用户侧或 loadgenerator 侧，证据引用用户侧现象或 loadgenerator 日志。  
- loadgenerator 自身 Pod/日志异常导致无法产生或无法到达 frontend：结论写 loadgenerator 对象及证据，不跳微服务下游 skill。  
- 多个下游同时异常或所有下游地址集体解析失败：先核对 frontend env 和下游 Service/EndpointSlice；若均正确，结论写集群 DNS/网络或平台侧，不直接归因单个下游。

## 结论怎么写

结论必须写明对象、原因、证据：对象是 frontend 的 Deployment/Pod/Service/EndpointSlice，或具体下游 Service；原因是镜像拉取失败、探针失败、资源限制、Service selector/端口错误、下游不可达等；证据引用具体事件、Pod 状态、EndpointSlice 状态或 frontend 日志中的下游地址错误。

fi

  --arg namespace "$SEL_NAMESPACE" --arg labels "$SEL_LABELS" --arg fields "$SEL_FIELDS" \

You are HolmesGPT version dev-unknown, an AI agent for troubleshooting and answering questions about DevOps, IT and observability systems, using tool calls to gather data.
Make multiple independent tool calls in parallel whenever possible — it saves the user time.
Do not say 'based on the tool output' or explicitly refer to tools at all.
If, after answering, you realize more tool calls are needed, you may call more tools at that point.
If you have a concrete suggestion for how the user can fix something, share it even if not asked explicitly.



If you are unsure how to satisfy the user's request, gather more information — including by asking the user. Prefer finding the answer yourself when you can.




# Skill Usage
If a skill in the catalog clearly matches the issue being investigated, fetch it with `fetch_skill` before diving into other tools — but only when it clearly matches, never speculatively.
Read the fetched skill's content and follow its steps; skill content takes priority over general investigation steps.




# Investigation guidelines

* Gather data with as many tool calls as needed before responding; keep going until you reach the deepest root cause you can find.
* Use the "five whys" approach: if a problem in service A traces to service B, investigate B too.
* Even after finding a root cause, keep investigating to find other possible causes and exact details (resource names, versions, labels). If there are multiple possible causes, list them in a numbered list.
* Always provide specific details from the user's environment — exact resource names, namespaces, versions — not generic examples.
* If you cannot find the resource the user referred to, assume a possible typo: try substrings and spelling variations.
* **Adjacent / similarly-named entities:** when the exact entity the user named has no data but similar-named ones do (siblings, same prefix/namespace), report both facts: state explicitly that you found nothing for the exact name (verbatim), report what you found in the similar entities, clearly labeled as coming from a different, related entity — never silently merge the user's name into the found ones — and suggest the user verify the name.
* Distinguish confirmed facts (directly observed in tool output) from hypotheses. Use hedging language ("possible", "likely", "may") for anything not directly confirmed; if the analysis is inconclusive, say so.
* Treat error messages as exact diagnostic evidence: `authentication failed` / `password authentication failed` for user X means user X EXISTS; `role does not exist` / `user not found` means the user is absent. These are mutually exclusive — never add "or the user may not exist" to an authentication failure.
* Do not conclude a resource is absent from a running system just because it isn't in deployment configuration — stateful systems accumulate state (SQL, API calls, admin operations) that leaves no K8s trace. If you can't read a value (e.g. a Secret), say you couldn't verify it rather than guessing.
* Data often contains errors that are irrelevant to the question — ignore them in your conclusion unless you tied them to the actual problem.
* ALWAYS check application logs when investigating whether an app, pod, service or deployment has issues — "running" and healthy-looking does not mean issue-free.

# Impact and blast radius

* Name an entity as affected only when you observed evidence for THAT entity — its own event, status/condition, log line or metric — and say what that evidence is (e.g. "`checkout-cache`: Evicted event, now Pending").
* Never widen the blast radius by inference. A node condition does not tell you which pods it hit; a failing dependency does not tell you which of its clients broke; an unhealthy shared component does not mean its consumers are unhealthy. Check each entity before you name it, or do not name it — sampling a workload's replicas characterizes the WORKLOAD, so attribute what you found to it rather than to replicas you did not look at.
* A restart, recreation, error or status change on an entity during the incident window is not impact until you have read its reason and found that it ties to this cause: the event's reason and message and who emitted it (`Evicted` from the kubelet is impact; `SuccessfulCreate` from a controller is a rollout), the container's last-state reason and exit code (`OOMKilled` vs `Completed`), or the log line. A pod that is 5 minutes old on a node that had trouble 5 minutes ago was not necessarily evicted — check what created it. Coincidence in time is not causation, and "also affected" is a claim that needs its own evidence.
* The same discipline applies to clearing entities: "X was unaffected" also needs a look. If you did not check, say you did not check.
* Entities you checked and found healthy are a finding worth reporting, not something to drop.
* Consequences you did not observe — downstream services, customer impact, data loss, other namespaces or clusters — are either verified before you state them, or marked explicitly as unverified with what would confirm them.
* Counts and scope words ("all", "several", "cluster-wide", "also affected") must match what you actually observed. Do not generalize from a sample you did not take.
* When you write up impact, sort every entity you name into one of four groups and label them: **Affected** — only entities with their own eviction, kill, error or failure evidence tied to this cause. Every line here quotes the exact reason token that proves it, in parentheses: `Evicted`, `OOMKilled`, `BackOff`, `Failed`, `Unhealthy` on a long-running pod, an error log line. If you cannot quote such a token for that entity, it does not go here — `SuccessfulDelete`, `SuccessfulCreate`, `Scheduled`, `Started` and a probe miss at startup are not among them. A recreation, restart or probe miss inside the window is never enough on its own, whatever sub-label you give it; **Checked, healthy** — you looked and found nothing wrong; **Changed during the window for another reason** — it restarted, was recreated or errored, and you name what did it (a controller rollout, a scheduled job, an operator, a probe at startup) and how you know; **Not checked**. Anything that changed during the window and that you cannot place in the first or third group goes in the fourth — it is not impact, and it does not go under an impact heading with a time-window qualifier as a substitute for a cause.

# If investigating Kubernetes problems

* Run as many kubectl commands as needed, walking the ownership chain (e.g. deployment → replicaset → pod) and checking both resource status and application logs.
* When a pod crashed or an application errors, always run kubectl_describe and fetch the logs.
* Don't stop at surface answers like "the pod is pending" or "node affinity doesn't match" — say why (which resource is short, which label doesn't match) and how to fix it.
* When many pods are affected, checking up to 3 representative pods per deployment is enough — to conclude about the DEPLOYMENT. Report the finding against the deployment; name an individual pod only when you looked at that pod.
* Eviction and OOM leave their mark on the pod: an `Evicted` event from the kubelet, or `OOMKilled` as a container's last termination reason. A pod that was deleted and recreated by its own controller — `SuccessfulDelete` / `SuccessfulCreate` from the daemonset-, replicaset- or statefulset-controller, a new pod name, a fresh `pod-template-generation`, Restart Count 0 — was rolled out or rescheduled by that controller, not damaged by the node, even when it happened in the same minute as the incident. For any pod younger than the incident, ask two things before you write about it: who created it (the `SuccessfulCreate` emitter), and whether the same controller replaced its siblings on other nodes in the same minutes — nodes that had no trouble. If it did, it was a rollout; write it as one, under "changed for another reason", never under impact. A startup readiness-probe miss on such a fresh pod is part of starting, not impact. Count a pod as affected only on its own eviction or kill evidence.
* If the user says something isn't working: describe the owner workload and pods (looking for transient issues), check for misconfigured ingresses/services, and read application logs for runtime issues.

- [E9]（CL02、CL04、CL05）【已排除】慢接口都调用某服务、快接口都不调用，不足以把变慢归给它；同一组接口共同调用的其他下游都是候选，Pod层指标正常、和调用方在同一节点也不能排除其网络路径。适用：按接口比较调用方日志耗时后，慢接口与快接口的调用差别对应不止一个下游（含间接调用和页面附属调用）。不适用：存在只调用其中一个候选的接口，且其耗时已在健康基线水平，能把候选区分开。做法：(1)为每个接口列出全部直接和间接下游，找出与慢接口调用集合重合的所有服务；(2)“快”接口要先和健康期基线比，若它也明显变慢，说明它同样经过慢点，不能当对照，它和慢接口共同调用的下游都要列为候选；(3)对每个候选分别取证：throttled占比、配置历史、探针事件、该Pod两端veth的tc qdisc；CPU低、throttled为0、无事件、丢包为0都不能排除tc延迟；(4)一次只修一个候选，每步看慢请求占比、中位数和p99，不变即排除。例：一次首页比健康期慢一个数量级却被当作快对照，变慢被归给推荐服务，清除两类页面都会调用的商品目录veth规则后全部恢复。
- [E10]（CL06、CL07）【已证实】调用方报下游返回 Unimplemented/Method not found 时，核对请求实际被路由到了哪个服务。适用：调用方或上游错误文本含 rpc error code = Unimplemented（如 Method not found），失败请求立即返回；预期的下游日志里没有对应调用。不适用：报 connection refused、i/o timeout 或 Endpoints 为空，按E1；下游自身日志有报错，改查该下游。做法：(1)从调用方启动日志或 env 取出该下游的 *_ADDR，与预期服务名和端口比较；(2)地址正确时查该 Service 的 selector 和 EndpointSlice 里的 Pod 名，看是否选中了另一个监听同端口服务的 Pod，可与其他 Service 的 EndpointSlice 对比；(3)看预期下游是否完全没有业务请求、被选中的服务日志是否只有它自己的方法；(4)比较当前配置与 last-applied-configuration 或上一版 ReplicaSet 模板，核对改动时间与症状起点；(5)改正后按E11确认各调用方已切到正确后端，再看 500 和对应操作失败数是否归零。Endpoints 都 ready、端口一致不能排除这类错误。例：一次支付地址指向了邮件服务；一次配送 Service 的 selector 选中了支付服务的 Pod。
- [E11]（CL07）【已证实】改正 Service selector、Endpoints 或地址后报错不降，要考虑调用方仍复用指向旧后端的长连接，按调用方逐个重建并分别验证。适用：路由配置已改正，EndpointSlice 已指向正确 Pod，但调用方日志里同一错误文本仍持续出现，500 或对应操作失败数不降；正确后端仍几乎收不到来自这些调用方的请求。不适用：EndpointSlice 仍为空或指向错误 Pod，先按E1、E10改正配置；正确后端已收到请求但自身报错，改查该后端。做法：(1)列出所有直接调用该下游的服务，把每个失败接口对应到实际发起这次调用的一方；(2)一次只重建（或让其重连）一个调用方，每步后分别看它负责的操作失败数和其余 500：只有它负责的那部分归零，说明各调用方各自持有旧连接，要逐个处理；(3)同时看正确后端日志是否开始出现来自该调用方的请求。调用方未重连前，失败不降不能当作配置修正无效的证据。例：一次改正配送 Service 的 selector 后 500 和下单失败都不变，重建结算服务后下单失败归零，再重建前端后 500 归零。

## 1. 权限与证据边界

- 只在命名空间 `boutique` 内排查，使用只读权限。
- 可查看：Pod、Pod 日志、事件、Service、EndpointSlice、Deployment、ReplicaSet、ConfigMap、ResourceQuota。
- 不可用：进入容器执行命令、查看节点、查看监控指标；系统没有 CPU、内存、延迟指标。
- 结论必须来自上述可见证据。无法验证的内容写成“先确认……”或“现有权限内无法确认”，不要根据服务名、调用关系或常见经验直接下根因。
- 不要编造日志格式、接口、配置项；日志字段含义先确认。

## 2. 调用关系

- 用户从 `frontend` 进入。
- `loadgenerator` 持续产生访问流量；其具体访问目标先确认，不纳入下列服务调用图，也不假设存在 `boutique-loadgenerator`。
- `frontend` -> `productcatalogservice`、`currencyservice`、`cartservice`、`recommendationservice`、`shippingservice`、`checkoutservice`、`adservice`
- `checkoutservice` -> `productcatalogservice`、`shippingservice`、`paymentservice`、`emailservice`、`currencyservice`、`cartservice`
- `recommendationservice` -> `productcatalogservice`
- `cartservice` -> `redis-cart`
- 不调用其他服务：`emailservice`、`paymentservice`、`productcatalogservice`、`currencyservice`、`shippingservice`、`adservice`、`redis-cart`

调用关系只表示依赖方向，不等于故障传播方向。

## 3. 入口 SOP 选择

先固定用户症状：发生时间、频率、影响的功能/操作、是否持续、是否与 `loadgenerator` 流量相关。不要先假定某个服务故障。

默认规则：

- 用户可见问题且无法明确指向某个后端服务：从 `boutique-frontend` 进入。
- 症状或已有证据明确指向某个服务及其对应操作：可直接进入该服务 SOP；仍要按第 4 节确认证据，不要跳过入口症状。
- 只有 `loadgenerator` 报错：先确认其访问目标和错误内容；若指向 `frontend` 或用户访问路径，从 `boutique-frontend` 进入。不要假设存在 `loadgenerator` 的 SOP。
- 不明确时回退到 `boutique-frontend`。

| 症状/已有证据明确指向 | 入口 skill |
|---|---|
| `frontend` 页面、入口、多个功能同时异常，或无法判断后端 | `boutique-frontend` |
| 商品目录、商品信息 | `boutique-productcatalogservice` |
| 币种、换算 | `boutique-currencyservice` |
| 购物车操作 | `boutique-cartservice` |
| 推荐内容 | `boutique-recommendationservice` |
| 运费、配送 | `boutique-shippingservice` |
| 下单、结账编排 | `boutique-checkoutservice` |
| 支付 | `boutique-paymentservice` |
| 邮件通知 | `boutique-emailservice` |
| 广告 | `boutique-adservice` |
| 已有证据指向购物车存储 `redis-cart`，或从 `cartservice` SOP 转入 | `boutique-redis-cart` |

## 4. 跨服务跳转原则

1. 只沿调用方向向下游跳，且必须带当前服务侧证据。可跳的证据包括：当前服务的日志、事件或状态显示对某个下游的调用失败、超时、连接失败、返回异常，并能定位到具体下游和操作；或当前服务自身已排除，请求路径明确只可能落在下游。仅凭“它是下游”“它也可能异常”不跳。
2. 跳转前记录：时间、当前服务对象、症状、指向下游的证据、已排除项。到下游后先核对同一时间窗、同一症状是否出现；对不上则回到当前服务，不能把无关异常归因给下游。
3. 反向查看调用方，只在当前服务有证据表明请求来源异常、请求内容异常或流量异常时进行；否则停在当前服务。
4. 结论归属：根因结论写在直接证据所在的最小服务上。调用方只写“受影响/依赖疑似异常”，不替下游下结论。若根因是调用方发出异常请求导致下游报错，结论写在调用方。多个服务受影响时，在源头服务写根因，在其他服务写影响并引用源头结论。
5. 停止条件：已定位到最小责任服务并有直接证据；或可见证据均不支持继续；或下一步需要进入容器、查看节点、查看监控指标、访问其他命名空间等无权限操作。停止时写明已排除项、未确认项、所需权限或补充信息，不要猜。

## 5. 多个服务同时异常时判断源头

- 先列出受影响服务、症状和最早异常时间，再按调用图找共同下游或共同依赖。共同依赖只是候选，不是根因。
- 看时序和错误形状：下游先异常、多个上游随后报同类依赖错误，优先查下游；上游先异常且下游日志或事件显示来自上游的异常请求/流量，优先查上游；只是同时异常不能定源。日志字段含义先确认。
- 对候选源头查直接证据：Pod 状态、日志、事件、Service、EndpointSlice、Deployment、ReplicaSet、ConfigMap、ResourceQuota。候选源头自身没有直接异常证据时，不把共同依赖写成源头，回到调用方或入口继续。
- 多个互不依赖分支同时异常：考虑共同入口 `frontend`、共同流量源 `loadgenerator`（先确认其目标和错误）、命名空间级限制如 ResourceQuota 等；仍须有可见证据。无法证明共同原因时，按多个独立故障记录，不要强行归并。
- 若所有下游均无直接异常，而入口持续报依赖错误，停止向下游跳转，回到入口检查其自身可见状态、端点和服务配置；仍无法确认则按权限边界交接。

            # frontend 排查 SOP

适用症状：用户从 frontend 入口访问 Online Boutique 出现页面不可用、报错或入口功能异常，或 loadgenerator 访问 frontend 失败/异常。

## 信号 → 步骤

| 能观察到的信号 | 去哪 |
|---|---|
| Deployment 可用副本 < 1；Pod 非 Running/Ready；CrashLoopBackOff、ImagePullBackOff、Pending、FailedCreate | 第 1 步 |
| Pod Running 且 Ready，但 frontend Service 访问异常，或 EndpointSlice 无 ready endpoint | 第 2 步 |
| frontend 日志出现下游服务地址/服务名的连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 | 第 3 步；单个下游持续异常时按“什么时候跳到别的服务”跳转 |
| 事件或日志显示 `/_healthz` 探针失败、容器重启 | 第 4 步 |
| Pod/Service/EndpointSlice 正常，但用户报入口不可用，或 loadgenerator 无法连接 frontend | 第 5 步 |
| 多个下游同时报错，或所有下游地址解析失败 | 第 3 步先核对 frontend env 和下游 Service/EndpointSlice，不直接跳单个下游 |
| 确认某个下游持续异常，frontend 自身正常 | 跳到 skill `boutique-<下游服务>` |
| frontend 及所有下游均正常，仅入口请求未到达或外部访问失败 | 第 5 步，结论写入口/用户侧或 loadgenerator 侧 |

## 步骤

1. **查 frontend Deployment、ReplicaSet、Pod 和事件，先排除本服务发布/资源问题。**  
   执行 `kubectl -n boutique get deploy,rs,pod -l app=frontend -o wide`，再对异常 Pod 执行 `kubectl -n boutique describe pod <pod>` 和查看命名空间事件。重点看：Deployment 的 desired/ready/available，Pod phase、Ready、restartCount、containerStatuses 的 waiting/terminated reason，事件中的 `ImagePullBackOff`、`ErrImagePull`、`CrashLoopBackOff`、`OOMKilled`、`FailedScheduling`、`FailedCreate`。  
   - 镜像拉取失败：本服务镜像问题，先确认镜像名是否为清单中的 `frontend:v0.10.3`、仓库是否可达、拉取凭据是否可用；只读账号不能看节点，不要归因节点。  
   - `OOMKilled` 或反复重启：结合 limits `memory: 128Mi`、容器日志和事件判断是否为内存限制；没有监控指标，不能靠 CPU/内存曲线下结论。  
   - `FailedCreate`/Pending 且事件提到配额：查看 `kubectl -n boutique get resourcequota`，确认是否 ResourceQuota 不足。  
   - Pod 未 Ready 且事件指向探针：转到第 4 步；Pod 正常则转第 2 步。

2. **查 frontend Service 和 EndpointSlice，确认入口 Service 是否把流量送到 Ready Pod。**  
   执行 `kubectl -n boutique get svc frontend -o yaml` 和 `kubectl -n boutique get endpointslice -l kubernetes.io/service-name=frontend -o yaml`。核对 Service 的 selector 是否为 `app: frontend`，端口是否为 `port: 80`、`targetPort: 8080`，EndpointSlice 是否有 ready addresses。  
   - selector 或端口与清单不一致：本服务 Service 配置问题。  
   - EndpointSlice 为空但 Pod 已 Ready：先确认 readinessProbe 是否通过、Service selector 是否匹配；必要时回第 1、4 步。  
   - EndpointSlice 有 ready endpoint 但用户仍访问失败：继续第 3、5 步，区分 frontend 应用错误与入口访问链路问题。

3. **查 frontend 日志中的下游调用错误，按下游拆分。**  
   执行 `kubectl -n boutique logs deploy/frontend --tail=<合适行数>`；若容器重启过，再看 `--previous`。先确认实际日志格式，不要预设字段。检索清单中的下游地址/服务名：`productcatalogservice:3550`、`currencyservice:7000`、`cartservice:7070`、`recommendationservice:8080`、`shippingservice:50051`、`checkoutservice:5050`、`adservice:9555`。  
   - 只有一个下游地址持续出现连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应，且 frontend Pod/Service/EndpointSlice/探针正常：按“什么时候跳到别的服务”跳对应 skill。  
   - 多个下游同时报错：先核对 frontend 的 env 地址是否与清单一致，并只读查看对应下游 Service/EndpointSlice 是否存在；不要直接归因单个下游。若 env 与清单不一致，按本服务配置问题处理。  
   - 所有下游地址集体解析失败：在确认 frontend env 正确、下游 Service 存在后，结论写集群 DNS/网络侧，不跳单个下游。  
   - 清单中有 `SHOPPING_ASSISTANT_SERVICE_ADDR=shoppingassistantservice:80`，但给定调用关系未列出该下游；先确认实际是否被调用，不要据此跳到未列出的服务。

4. **查探针和 frontend 运行配置。**  
   核对 Deployment 中 `PORT=8080`、containerPort `8080`、readinessProbe/livenessProbe 均为 `httpGet /_healthz:8080`，并带清单中的 Cookie 头；initialDelaySeconds 均为 10。查看 Pod 事件和日志中是否出现探针失败、未监听端口、启动失败。  
   - 应用未监听 8080、PORT/containerPort/探针端口不一致：本服务配置问题。  
   - 探针失败同时伴随下游连接错误：回第 3 步判断是否由下游依赖导致。  
   - 探针失败但无下游错误：结论写 frontend Pod/探针配置或应用启动问题，证据用事件和日志。

5. **确认入口请求是否到达 frontend。**  
   用用户报告、loadgenerator Pod 状态/日志辅助判断，先确认 loadgenerator 实际日志格式。若 frontend 日志有持续请求且错误指向下游，回第 3 步；若 frontend 日志无请求、loadgenerator 日志显示无法连接 frontend，而 frontend Service/EndpointSlice 正常，检查第 2 步并判断为入口访问链路/用户侧或 loadgenerator 侧问题。frontend 是入口，没有上游微服务调用方；不要把它写成某个下游服务的调用方问题。loadgenerator 只作为流量来源，不写成 frontend 的下游服务。

6. **汇总结论并决定跳转。**  
   汇总 frontend Deployment/Pod/Service/EndpointSlice 状态、事件、日志中的下游地址错误，按下一节决定跳下游还是写入口侧结论。不要只写“重启/扩容试试”。

## 什么时候跳到别的服务

仅当 frontend Pod Running/Ready、frontend Service/EndpointSlice 正常、探针无明显失败，且 frontend 日志持续指向单个下游时跳转：

- frontend 日志持续出现 `productcatalogservice:3550` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-productcatalogservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `currencyservice:7000` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-currencyservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `cartservice:7070` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-cartservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `recommendationservice:8080` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-recommendationservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `shippingservice:50051` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-shippingservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `checkoutservice:5050` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-checkoutservice`。  
- frontend 日志持续出现 `adservice:9555` 连接失败、超时、解析失败或非预期响应 → 跳到 skill `boutique-adservice`。  

回到调用方/入口侧的情形：

- frontend Deployment/Pod/Service/EndpointSlice 均正常，所有下游也未见持续错误，但用户访问失败或请求未到达 frontend：frontend 无上游微服务调用方，结论写在入口/用户侧或 loadgenerator 侧，证据引用用户侧现象或 loadgenerator 日志。  
- loadgenerator 自身 Pod/日志异常导致无法产生或无法到达 frontend：结论写 loadgenerator 对象及证据，不跳微服务下游 skill。  
- 多个下游同时异常或所有下游地址集体解析失败：先核对 frontend env 和下游 Service/EndpointSlice；若均正确，结论写集群 DNS/网络或平台侧，不直接归因单个下游。

## 结论怎么写

结论必须写明对象、原因、证据：对象是 frontend 的 Deployment/Pod/Service/EndpointSlice，或具体下游 Service；原因是镜像拉取失败、探针失败、资源限制、Service selector/端口错误、下游不可达等；证据引用具体事件、Pod 状态、EndpointSlice 状态或 frontend 日志中的下游地址错误。  
跳下游时写“frontend 本身正常，问题在 `<下游服务>`”，并附 frontend 日志证据；入口侧时写“frontend 及下游均正常，入口请求未到达/外部访问失败”，并附用户侧或 loadgenerator 观察证据。

- 9524ed74: 05.2486 → 05.2801 (31ms)

- 04.368067 (≈ ff36ddc7 complete 04.3698) ✓ home ff36ddc7's ad at very end
- 05.279084 (9524ed74 complete 05.2801) ✓

- 19.404687 (62298955 complete 19.4057) ✓ same pattern: ad at end.
- 19.420785 (cdd2a793 complete 19.4217) ✓

So home page DOES call ads at the very end, and for the slow homes the ad call is issued ~5s after the previous downstream activity, and then the ad request arrives immediately (08.5998 → complete 08.6013 = 1.5ms). So the ads hop is fast; the 5s wait happens *before* the ads call.

So what happens between the last conversion (~03.595) and the ads call (08.5998)? In homeHandler, after conversions... hmm, and before ads. If home page fetches ads at the end (after conversions), then the 5s is in the ads-fetch *preparation*? No — the ad request arrives instantly after.

Wait — maybe order is: currencies → products → cart → conversions → ??? → ads. The ??? for home page... Could be a *recommendations* fetch? No.

Hmm! Actually maybe homeHandler does:
```go
	// Ads
	ads := ...
```
but before that, something like `fe.getShippingQuote`? No, that's cart page.

OK: alternatively my assumption about the 9 conversion lines belonging to a *single* request is wrong. What if for the slow home, conversions were split: e.g., only some conversions happened at 03.588, and the rest later? But there were exactly 9-10 events at 03.586-03.595 (GetSupported + 9 conversions) = complete set.

Hmm, so what about the *productcatalog* ListProducts call: could the home fetch products AFTER conversions? No, prices are needed.

Unless... the void is INSIDE the frontend: e.g., a `time.Sleep`? Or the platform detection making an HTTP call to the GCP metadata server (169.254.169.254) with a timeout! Remember the two ERROR logs at startup:
"Failed to fetch the name of the cluster in which the pod is running Get http://169.254.169.254/... connection refused"
"Failed to fetch the Zone of the node ... connection refused"

Interesting! Those are from a GCP metadata client. If some per-request code path queries the metadata server (169.254.169.254) — which is unreachable — a request could hang for 5s (connection refused is fast though).

Hmm, but that STARTUP error shows "connection refused" quickly.

Alternatively: the frontend v0.10.3 has a "platform" feature: `ENV_PLATFORM` local/gcp/... In v0.10.3 frontend there's code:

```go
// platform returns the platform the app is running on
func (fe *frontendServer) getPlatform() string
```
Hmm, and there's a tracer/exporter setup that queries metadata for clusterName/zone (that's the startup errors — from the OpenTelemetry/GCP detector).

Wait, actually the "env platform is either empty or invalid" + "ENV_PLATFORM is: local" strongly suggests frontend code reads ENV_PLATFORM per request. The deployment env does NOT define ENV_PLATFORM! So it's empty → warning printed per request, then defaults to "local".

Where in the request path? Could be in `platformDetail` for the home page... 

Regardless, the 5s void might be a metadata/HTTP call. 5s is also the default timeout for... Hmm.

New idea: check loadgenerator side. The loadgenerator is Locust; user-perceived latency is what the user reported. Frontend's own took_ms is our measure — fine.

Let me try yet another angle: is the 5s void correlated with a specific *session/user*? Slow homes: 15ed357a (session d756b212), 62298955 (session aedcbc36), 72331960 (bd5a5dfd), ac1dffbf (add88f57), 4d9120c9 (aedcbc36), f9a2b0d1 (60571032). Not one session.

Alternatively, maybe the void is the *cart* call, and the conversions I see at the start belong to a *different* request. Ugh, but I verified 15ed357a: GetSupported at 03.586 (0.8ms after start) then 9 conversions within 9ms. Wait... could those 9 conversions belong to a *cart page* request in flight? Cart page requests also do GetSupported + per-item conversions but they start with a distinct GetSupported. In 03.0-04.0 window only ONE GetSupported appeared (03.586) — belonging to 15ed357a.

So the conversions are 15ed357a's. Fine.

Therefore in homeHandler, after conversions there's a 5s block before the ad call. What could that be? Let me think about v0.10.3 homeHandler more carefully. I recall:

```go
func (fe *frontendServer) homeHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	...
	// convert currencies
	...
	// fetch ads
	var ads []*pb.Ad
	...
```
Hmm, I genuinely recall in v0.10.3 there is a "getAds" in home via `fe.chooseAd`? And there's also:

```go
	if fe.assistantSvcAddr != "" { ... }
```
Hmm.

Alternatively there's `fe.getRecommendations`? no.

Honestly, we might not need the exact internal. Alternative hypothesis: the 5s void is a *TCP-level* stall on the frontend→adservice connection: the ad call is issued at 03.6, packets get lost, gRPC waits... with no deadline for home ads. Then the ad request finally arrives at 08.5998 (5s later, after TCP retransmission with exponential backoff: 200+400+800+1600+3200 = 6200; or 1+2+... hmm). Then the response returns in 1.5ms. Then complete.

But then the ad request would arrive at 08.5998 exactly — which matches! And the frontend got the response within 1.5ms.

So: the ad RPC from frontend was issued at ~03.6 (after conversions) and the request only reached adservice at 08.5998 — a ~5s delay in delivering the request. Since product-page ads use a 100ms deadline, they time out and warn (DeadlineExceeded) — consistent with the 10 warnings! And home ads have no deadline (or a long one) so it waits 5s.

Hmm, but not all home ad calls are delayed: ff36ddc7's ad arrived at 04.368 (13ms after start) — fast. So probabilistic.

Now: is the delay specific to the frontend→adservice path? Or to adservice's pod (ingress on its veth)? We can distinguish: adservice has no downstream, so any delay affecting adservice affects only ad calls. If the delay were on the *frontend* pod, all hops would suffer.

Do other hops suffer? Yes: cart ops +200ms, product pages +100-400ms. Hmm, those could be other hops or the frontend itself.

Let me check the product page composition. Product page calls: GetProduct (catalog), currencies(2), GetCart, ListRecommendations (recommendationservice→catalog×N), GetAds.

Product page slow clusters: +100, +200, +300, +400. If the ads call has a 100ms deadline, a delayed ads call contributes exactly +100 (timeout). But product page 106ms ones: e.g., 7b758f93 107ms with ads DeadlineExceeded → so +100 = ads timeout ✓. And 214ms ones: +200 could be ads timeout (100) + something else (100)? E.g., recommendations delayed?

Hmm, but ads DeadlineExceeded warnings are only ~10 in 4 min while product pages are far more numerous; most product pages are 6-10ms (fast). So most ad calls are fast.

Let me count: over 12:47:02–12:47:16 (14s), adservice received 21 ad requests. Frontend served how many page views in that time? ~30 (products+home). So ads calls ≈ number of product+home pages ≈ ok.

So the distribution: most ad calls fast, some delayed ~+100 (timeout), some ~5s (home, no deadline).

A ~100ms delay unit + occasional 5s. TCP RTO would be 200ms min. So a *fixed netem delay* of ~50ms each way = 100ms RTT could produce +100ms. And 5s? Hmm, if netem delay is applied to a percentage of packets (e.g., 50% of packets delayed 50ms), the RPC's first packet(s) may be delayed... you'd get +50 or +100, not 5s.

What if there's *packet loss* on the adservice veth: loss → TCP RTO 200ms (or fast retransmit), and for a page whose ad call times out at 100ms (product) → +100. Home (no deadline) waits for the retransmit: 200, 400, ... For 5s, several consecutive losses.

Hmm, but 5014/5015 exactly repeated 4 times for home = deterministic. With random loss, unlikely.

5s = DNS timeout (5s default timeout in resolv.conf). Adservice is a Java/Netty app... but DNS is resolved by the *frontend* (client side), which is Go: Go's resolver with `timeout:5` waits 5s and then retries. If a DNS query for "adservice" is lost, Go's dial would wait 5s then retry. And frontend re-dials when a connection fails. Hmm! But frontend uses persistent gRPC connections; a reconnect would trigger DNS.

Hmm, but why adservice specifically? Because adservice's connection was broken earlier ("connection refused" at 12:45:04-09 when the pod wasn't listening yet) → gRPC backoff/reconnect → repeated DNS lookups. Also the 100ms deadline would cancel each attempt → repeated re-dials → DNS queries.

Wait, actually: our frontend at 12:44-12:45 had connection refused for ads, then at 12:47:10 etc. DeadlineExceeded.

Hmm, alternatively the delay is in the *kube-dns/CoreDNS* path (also on the single node). If DNS is slow/lossy, all services would see reconnect delays — but only when re-resolving.

Hold on, let me reconsider the cart +200ms. If DNS for "cartservice"/"redis-cart" were slow... cartservice's redis connection is persistent too.

Hmm, what about the possibility that the whole node's network stack is fine but there's an intermittent delay affecting a pod. We have pod-level network counters: drops 0, errors 0 everywhere. Not helpful for netem.

I'm running low on discriminating power without tc access. Let me reconsider the measurements once more:

Cart page slow values: 102, 115, 148, 193, 198, 202, 214, 217, 219, 223, 225, 226, 228, 230, 230, 230, 334, 369, 435, 635.
Product page slow: 100, 106, 106, 107, 107, 108, 135, 155, 214, 214, 218, 218, 219, 220, 221, 222, 223, 227, 230, 232, 234, 237, 291, 316, 316, 349, 386, 425, 425, 434.
POST /cart: 206, 216, 220, 224 (i.e., ~+205-224).

Note the cart page has 148 and the product page has 135, 155 — those are odd. And clusters: ~100-115 (×1), ~135-155 (?), ~193-237 (×2), ~290-390 (×3), ~425-435 (×4), 635 (×6?).

Hmm, an alternative unit: ~100ms with jitter. If each "hit" adds ~100-115ms, then:
- 1 hit: 100-115 (+135, 155 as 1.5?)
- 2 hits: 193-237
- 3 hits: 291-386
- 4 hits: 425-435
- 6 hits: 635

Now POST /cart has exactly ONE downstream call (cartservice AddItem) and shows exactly 1 hit (206-224). So a single RPC to cartservice can take +200 (~2 units of 100ms). That means the delay is per-packet, and one RPC = 2 packet traversals (req+resp) × 100ms.

Then product page = 5 RPCs; if the delay applies with some probability per packet, product page hits would be 1-4 units. And 5s occurrences on home: home = 13 RPCs...

Hmm, what if the delay is a *loss* with probability p per packet, and each loss = 200ms RTO retransmit? Then POST /cart = 1 RPC = 2 packets, 1-2 losses = +200 ✓. And a 5s home = several losses... could be.

The deterministic 5014/5015 bugs me. 5014 = 5s + 14 (the normal fast home time is 11-14ms!). So slow home = 5.000s + normal processing. That's a fixed 5s. And 5706 = 5.0s + 700ms (extra 700 from other delays). 5111 = 5.0s + 100ms.

So home has an extra exactly-5.000s occasionally. And exactly-5.000s is the DNS resolver timeout in Go? Actually Go's default resolv.conf timeout is 5s with 2 attempts. If the DNS server (CoreDNS) is unreachable for a query, Go waits 5s, then retries → 10s. If the second attempt succeeds... For our case: 5s then success. That means: first DNS query timed out after 5s, retry succeeded instantly. Hmm, plausible: a lost UDP DNS query + 5s timeout + retry.

But the DNS query would only occur on a new connection. Which connection would be re-established right at that moment? The ad call!? But the ad request arrived 1.5ms before completion — meaning after the 5s, the dial resolved and the call completed instantly. Hmm, that fits DNS: 5s DNS timeout, then successful resolution+dial+call = 1.5ms? Dial+call in 1.5ms is plausible on a local node.

But wait: if the frontend had to re-dial adservice for this call, that means the gRPC connection was broken (transient). grpc.Dial per call? In v0.10.3, frontend creates connections once in main (mustConnGRPC). Hmm, but the ad call with 100ms deadline: when the deadline expires mid-dial, the connection attempt is cancelled; the connection then goes to transient failure and reconnects with backoff → each subsequent ad call may trigger a new dial → DNS lookup. So slow DNS (or lost DNS queries) would produce: some ad calls hit a fresh dial → each fresh dial requires DNS → if that DNS query is lost, 5s (home, no deadline... hmm but the ad call would also be subject to some deadline).

But the product-page ads do time out at 100ms → consistent: they hit a reconnect+slow DNS and give up at 100ms.

The home page ad call: no warning, waited 5s → so home's ad call has no 100ms deadline (or a >5s deadline). Then it eventually succeeded.

So the pattern for the 5s: frontend→adservice connection is flapping (because calls time out at 100ms, cancelling dials), and re-dials sometimes wait ~5s (DNS or TCP SYN retry — TCP SYN retry with 1s,3s,... hmm 5s isn't a standard SYN backoff).

Hmm, but why would the frontend's adservice connection be broken at all? Because adservice was refusing connections at 12:45:04-09 and each 100ms-deadline cancellation puts it into transient failure. Once a gRPC connection is established and healthy, calls would be fast. The warnings continue through 12:48:31, spread out — consistent with repeated flapping.

Hmm, hold on. Alternative for the 5s: **adservice pod's own JVM being slow**? No, ad request ingress observed at 08.5998 and complete at 08.6013 — the response took 1.5ms.

OK, let me now check: are there 5s stalls on paths other than home? Look at the >100ms list: any /cart or /product at ~5000? No. Only "/" has 5014-5706. And home is the only page that calls ads without a deadline? Hmm, but then a "5s ad" would produce 5000+ on home only. ✓ Consistent!

But also home sometimes shows 224/234/148/111 (i.e., +100/+200): consistent with 1-2 units, which could be from other hops (cart, currency, catalog) or a 100ms ad timeout... but home's ads don't time out (no warnings for /) — so the +100/+200 on home comes from other hops.

Hmm, wait. So which hop gives +100/+200 on cart/product pages? POST /cart (only cartservice) gives +205-224 → the cart hop. GET /cart: cart hop too. Product page: cart hop as well (GetCart!).

So: cart hop sometimes +200ms. Ad call: sometimes +100 (timeout) — that's just the deadline, not necessarily a delay... but no: a timeout means it took >100ms. Why would adservice be >100ms sometimes? Both cart and ads slow...

Hmm, so maybe the delay affects the *frontend pod's* egress (or the node's bridge/veth for frontend). If the frontend pod had netem delay of ~50-100ms with a percentage, then:
- Fast requests unaffected (delay applied to a fraction of packets).
- POST /cart: 1 RPC → sometimes +200 (2 delayed packets: req+resp, each 100ms).
- Product page: 5 RPCs → +100..+400.
- Ads calls: sometimes exceed the 100ms deadline → DeadlineExceeded ✓ (and the ad request arriving 350ms late in the efefcafd case ✓✓ — the request itself was delayed in transit!)
- Home pages: 13 RPCs; the ad call at the end occasionally delayed so much it took 5s?? Hmm.

The efefcafd evidence is strong: frontend issued the ad call at ~10.17, adservice received at 10.516 (350ms later), frontend gave up at 10.276. So packets from frontend→adservice took 350ms. That's a network-path delay, not adservice compute. Where? Either on the frontend's egress or adservice's ingress (veth).

If it were on the frontend's egress, ALL hops would show delays and cart/currency/etc. would be slow — currency ingress was timely in the home cases... but those were requests where currency was fast. Let me check a case where currency ingress was LATE relative to a frontend request. From the timeline: every GetSupportedCurrencies matched a frontend start within ~1ms — no visible delays. So frontend's egress to currency is fine, and currency's ingress is fine.

How about catalog? We saw the 500 at startup with productcatalog "i/o timeout" — frontend→productcatalog packets were dropped (10:96.154.144:3550). That was startup.

So: currency is fine; adservice ingress is delayed; cartservice hop is delayed (POST /cart +200). Hmm — two "delayed" hops? That suggests the *frontend's* egress in general, but currency observations contradict... unless the currency path is fine because those particular packets weren't delayed (probabilistic delays!).

Given probabilistic per-packet delay on the frontend pod, we'd expect currency ingress to be occasionally late too — matching a "Getting supported currencies" that comes, e.g., 100ms after the frontend request start. In the timeline I compared, all home/product/cart requests' first currency ingress matched start times within ~1ms... except let me check 2101/2207/2208: "Getting supported currencies" at 12:47:07.101 and 07.207 — matches cart e2ea1944 (start 07.101) and product 6664a7ad (start 07.206). ✓.

Hmm, so no currency delays observed at all in ~55 samples. That's evidence currency is NOT affected.

Now catalog? Can't see ingress (no request logs). Cart? No timestamps. So we have: ads delayed (confirmed), cart delayed (+200 on single-RPC POST /cart, confirmed), currency not delayed, catalog unknown.

Interesting: what do ads and cart have in common vs currency? Hmm, currency is Node.js, cart is .NET, ads is Java, catalog is Go.

Alternatively: the *cart* delay on POST /cart could be inside cartservice (cart→redis). And the ad delay could be inside adservice? No — the ad ingress log was 350ms late, which is transit, and adservice logged receipt 350ms after frontend sent. Unless... adservice's log write is buffered? Log4j async? Hmm, it logs "received ad request" at handler start. The delay could also be in the JVM thread pool: gRPC's executor thread busy → but "threadId":20 same thread; if the gRPC server's executor is saturated, the handler entry is delayed → logs appear late. That's plausible if adservice's CPU is saturated... CPU usage 7m of 300m limit, no throttling. Hmm.

Wait, but there's a much better explanation for adservice: JVM GC. If adservice has long GC pauses, the handler runs late (log line delayed) — GC pause would delay both log emission and the RPC. But 350ms GC pauses in the first minutes of a JVM... plausible (JIT/GC). But 5s?

Hmm hold on. What about the pattern where the p99 user-side is 5015ms and the frontend home page shows exactly 5s: maybe that's a JVM-related 5s? no.

New approach: look at the network counters over the window to find a pod with drops/retransmits. The provided metrics only counted 30s. Drops/errors are 0 for all. Not decisive.

Let me look at pod-level metrics again with a different window to compare and check whether throttling appears for some pods (e.g., redis-cart at 125m limit, frontend 200m). Take window 45s.

Also check recommendationservice logs (may log per-request timings) and shippingservice, and the checkoutservice full logs to see per-step timings (checkout has warnings with detail).

Let me also reconsider: the user says "偶尔有页面要等很久" and p99 5015ms. The 5s stalls are on home page. We have solid evidence:
- Ads call delayed: frontend issues ad RPC, adservice logs receipt seconds later (5.004s in the 15ed357a case; 350ms in efefcafd).

Wait! For 15ed357a: last conversion 03.595, ad received 08.5998. If the home ad call is issued right after conversions + render prep, then received 5s later. Yes.

So the ad hop is where the delays are. But is the delay on the adservice side (its veth / its process)?

Critically: adservice is the only service whose ingress we can compare with client-issued time... and its delay is clear.

Can I check cartservice ingress? cartservice logs have no timestamps. Damn. But .NET logs without timestamps... the log content order only.

What about recommendationservice? Let's check its log format — Python, may log with timestamps. If a product page's recommendations call shows a delayed ingress, we'd see another delayed hop.

Let me look at recommendationservice logs. And shippingservice (Go, logs per request?), checkoutservice (Go: logs?).

Actually, on reflection: which hop would explain +200ms on POST /cart (cartservice only)? If cartservice were delayed on ingress, that also explains cart page +200 and product page (which calls GetCart). And home page calls GetCart too — home +100/+200 ✓ (some homes at 111-234).

And adservice delayed: ad calls time out at 100ms.

So TWO hops delayed: cartservice and adservice? Or ONE common factor: the *frontend* pod's egress with probabilistic delay? But then currency ingress would also be late sometimes (55 samples, none late... though currency calls are the *first* call of a page, immediately after the page request arrives, and 55 samples with p maybe 10% would show ~5 late → we saw none).

Alternatively the delay is on the *node's* bridge for certain veths.

Hmm, what about the loadgenerator? Users are Locust; the reported p99 5015ms is user-side. Fine.

Let me now check redis-cart: cartservice→redis. If redis is delayed, cart ops take +200. Redis pod is on same node.

Hmm, what about the *redis-cart* pod being paused? CPU limit 125m, requests 70m, usage 1m. If redis is CPU starved... no throttling observed.

Let me try a completely different, potentially decisive check: are there any pods whose *processes* are being delayed by the OS (e.g., cgroup freezer?), or is there something like a Pumba/netem sidecar? Let's inspect the pods' details: containers per pod (maybe a sidecar injecting latency), annotations.

Let me check pod specs fully for frontend, adservice, cartservice, redis-cart: containers, initContainers, annotations, securityContext, dnsPolicy, hostNetwork.

messages.reasoning_content:
No CPU throttling (frontend 1/172 in window = 0.6%; not significant). No sidecars (the istio annotation exists but no istio sidecar container). No chaos CRDs visible.

So CPU throttling is ruled out.

Now the network metrics show no drops/errors.

I need to identify where the delay is. Let me think about the ad evidence again more rigorously, because that's the clearest measurement: frontend issues ad call at T, adservice logs receipt at T+Δ.

Case: efefcafd product page start 10.1686. Ads warning at 10.2764 (DeadlineExceeded, so frontend deadline ~100ms after ~10.176). Adservice received at 10.177 (footwear) — that's the request! Look: adservice log at 12:47:10.177029 "received ad request (context_words=[footwear])" — that's 8ms after the frontend request start, and the frontend's deadline expired at 10.2764. Then adservice log at 10.516785 "footwear" — a second footwear ad request!

So which one is efefcafd's? The product page 9ECAV7KIM = footwear category. There are two footwear requests: 10.177 and 10.516. The frontend sent its ad request ~10.176 and gave up at 10.276 (100ms). Adservice received at 10.177 — timely! So adservice received it quickly but the *response* didn't come back within 100ms — meaning adservice took >100ms to respond (JVM), OR the response was delayed in transit.

**延迟只出现在“返回 frontend 的响应回程”上，下游服务自身处理都是毫秒/微秒级：**

| 观测 | 数据 |
|---|---|

| 慢首页 `62298955` | 5706ms；GetSupportedCurrencies 在 13.699 即时到达，最后一次 conversion 14.351，页面 19.4057 才结束 |
| 请求方向正常 | 55 个页面样本中 `Getting supported currencies...` 均在页面开始后 **0–1ms** 到达 currencyservice |
| adservice | 12:47:10.1686 的 product 页，adservice 于 10.177 收到请求（+2ms），frontend 却在 10.276 以 100ms 截止超时（`DeadlineExceeded`，4 分钟内 10 次）→ 响应回程 >100ms |
| cartservice | `POST /cart` 只调用一次 `AddItem`，正常 1ms，偶发 **206/216/220/224ms** |
| productcatalogservice | `a5172a49`（135ms）：getProduct 花了 126ms（currency 调用在 start+126ms 才到达），服务端 CPU 6m/200m、无日志错 |
| 对照客户端 | checkoutservice 的 `[PlaceOrder]`→`payment went through` 全程 **5–8ms**（14 次样本），期间要访问 cartservice、productcatalogservice、currencyservice、shippingservice → 这些下游对另一客户端毫无变慢 |
| 下游处理耗时 | shippingservice `GetQuote` 收到→完成 39µs；cartservice 无任何 error/timeout 日志 |

未确认项（两种解释无法区分，需节点权限）：延迟规则是加在 **frontend Pod 的入方向 veth/qu​disc**，还是加在**各下游 Pod veth 的出方向**。前者的支持证据是 checkoutservice 调同样几个下游不变慢（指向“回 frontend 的这一段”）；后者也无法用现有权限排除。需要 `tc -s qdisc show dev <veth>`（节点 `tiktok-k8s-lab-control-plane` 上 frontend 与各下游 Pod 两端）确认。
